exposure: maternal tobacco exposure during pregnancy (assessed by AHRR gene methylation marker cg05575921 in newborn dried blood spots)
polygenetic risk score for childhood ALL
cohort: The study participants were children from two large population-based studies of childhood ALL in California, where maternal tobacco exposure was assessed using newborn dried blood spots.
finding: AHRR hypomethylation alone was not associated with childhood ALL, but several genetic variants, particularly in PTPRK and DPP6, showed significant interaction with AHRR hypomethylation in relation to childhood ALL risk.
